```{r}
#WBC
mean(data$total_wbc)
var(data$total_wbc)
sd(data$total_wbc)

#square root
data$sqrt_total_wbc <- sqrt(data$total_wbc)

#Model
m_wbc <- glmmTMB(
  sqrt_total_wbc ~ Treatment + Body_mass + (1|Tank_ID),
  family = gaussian(),
  data = data
)

summary(m_wbc)

res_wbc <- simulateResiduals(m_wbc)
plot(res_wbc)
testDispersion(res_wbc)

Anova (m_wbc)
emm_wbc <- emmeans(m_wbc, ~ Treatment)

pairs(emm_wbc, adjust = "tukey")
```

```{r}
# Plotting WBC

# 2) Refit model with updated Treatment factor
m_wbc <- glmmTMB(
  sqrt_total_wbc ~ Treatment + Body_mass + (1 | Tank_ID),
  family = gaussian(),
  data = data
)

# 3) Estimated marginal means
emm_wbc <- emmeans(m_wbc, ~ Treatment)

emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm_wbc)

# 4) Back-transform estimates to original WBC scale
emm_df <- emm_df %>%
  mutate(
    mean_wbc  = emmean^2,
    lower_wbc = lower.CL^2,
    upper_wbc = upper.CL^2
  )

# 5) Colour palettes
pastel_cols <- c(
  "Control" = "#A8D5BA",
  "low"     = "#F9E79F",
  "high"    = "#F5B7B1"
)

dark_cols <- c(
  "Control" = "#2E8B57",
  "low"     = "#C9A227",
  "high"    = "#B22222"
)

# 6) Plot
p_wbc <- ggplot() +

  geom_violin(
    data = data,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = total_wbc, fill = Treatment),
    alpha = 0.20,
    colour = NA,
    trim = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    data = data,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = total_wbc, colour = Treatment),
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 2
  ) +

  geom_errorbar(
    data = emm_df,
    aes(
      x = Treatment,
      ymin = lower_wbc,
      ymax = upper_wbc,
      colour = Treatment
    ),
    width = 0.25,
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +

  geom_point(
    data = emm_df,
    aes(
      x = Treatment,
      y = mean_wbc,
      fill = Treatment
    ),
    shape = 21,
    size = 5,
    stroke = 1.2,
    colour = "black"
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(values = dark_cols) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pastel_cols) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +

  labs(
    x = "Fluoxetine treatment",
    y = "White blood cell count"
  ) +

  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# Display plot
p_wbc

# 7) Save figure
ggsave(
  filename = here::here("figures", "total_wbc.pdf"),
  plot = p_wbc,
  width = 6,
  height = 5
)

ggsave(
  filename = here::here("figures", "total_wbc.jpg"),
  plot = p_wbc,
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)

```

```{r}
#N/L ratio
mean(data$N.L_ratio)
var(data$N.L_ratio)
sd(data$N.L_ratio)

data$log_NL <- log(data$N.L_ratio)
hist(data$log_NL)

#Model
m_NL <- glmmTMB(
  log_NL ~ Treatment + Body_mass + (1|Tank_ID),
  family = gaussian(),
  data = data
)

summary(m_NL)

res_NL <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(m_NL)
plot(res_NL)
DHARMa::testDispersion(res_NL)

Anova(m_NL)
emm_NL <- emmeans(m_NL, ~ Treatment)
pairs(emm_NL, adjust = "tukey")

```

```{r}
# Plotting N:L ratio

# 1) Ensure treatment order BEFORE fitting the model
data$Treatment <- factor(
  data$Treatment,
  levels = c("Control", "low", "high")
)

# 2) Refit model after setting treatment order
m_NL <- glmmTMB(
  log_NL ~ Treatment + Body_mass + (1 | Tank_ID),
  family = gaussian(),
  data = data
)

# 3) Colours
pastel_cols <- c(
  "Control" = "#A8D5BA",
  "low"     = "#F9E79F",
  "high"    = "#F5B7B1"
)

dark_cols <- c(
  "Control" = "#2E8B57",
  "low"     = "#C9A227",
  "high"    = "#B22222"
)

# 4) Get emmeans on log scale and back-transform
emm_NL_df <- emmeans(m_NL, ~ Treatment) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("Control", "low", "high")),
    emmean_bt = exp(emmean),
    lower_bt  = exp(lower.CL),
    upper_bt  = exp(upper.CL)
  )

# Check estimates before plotting
emm_NL_df

# 5) Plot
p_nl_ratio <- ggplot() +

  geom_violin(
    data = data,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = N.L_ratio, fill = Treatment),
    alpha = 0.35,
    colour = NA,
    trim = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    data = data,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = N.L_ratio, colour = Treatment),
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 2
  ) +

  geom_errorbar(
    data = emm_NL_df,
    aes(
      x = Treatment,
      ymin = lower_bt,
      ymax = upper_bt,
      colour = Treatment
    ),
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +

  geom_point(
    data = emm_NL_df,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = emmean_bt, fill = Treatment),
    shape = 21,
    size = 5,
    stroke = 1.2,
    colour = "black"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = pastel_cols) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = dark_cols) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +

  labs(
    x = "Fluoxetine treatment",
    y = "N:L ratio"
  ) +

  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p_nl_ratio

# Save
ggsave(
  filename = here::here("figures", "nl_ratio.pdf"),
  plot = p_nl_ratio,
  width = 6,
  height = 5
)

ggsave(
  filename = here::here("figures", "nl_ratio.jpg"),
  plot = p_nl_ratio,
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)
```


```{r}
# Lymphocytes
m_lymph_bb <- glmmTMB(
  cbind(Lymphocyte, 100 - Lymphocyte) ~ Treatment + Body_mass + (1|Tank_ID),
  family = betabinomial(link="logit"),
  data = data
)

summary(m_lymph_bb)

res_lymph_bb <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(m_lymph_bb)
plot(res_lymph_bb)
DHARMa::testDispersion(res_lymph_bb)

Anova(m_lymph_bb)
emm_lymph <- emmeans(m_lymph_bb, ~ Treatment)
pairs(emm_lymph, adjust = "tukey")


```

```{r}
#Neutrophils
mean(data$Neutrophil)
var(data$Neutrophil)
sd(data$Neutrophil)

# Beta-binomial model
m_neut_bb <- glmmTMB(
  cbind(Neutrophil, 100 - Neutrophil) ~ Treatment + Body_mass + (1|Tank_ID),
  family = betabinomial(link="logit"),
  data = data
)

summary(m_neut_bb)

res_neut_bb <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(m_neut_bb)

DHARMa::testDispersion(res_neut_bb)
```

```{r}
#PLotting Lymphocytes and neutrophils
# Ensure treatment order
data$Treatment <- factor(data$Treatment, levels = c("Control", "low", "high"))

# ---------------------------
# 1) Long-format raw data
# ---------------------------
raw_long <- data %>%
  select(Treatment, Lymphocyte, Neutrophil) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Lymphocyte, Neutrophil),
               names_to = "Cell_type",
               values_to = "Percent") %>%
  mutate(Cell_type = factor(Cell_type, levels = c("Lymphocyte", "Neutrophil")))

# ---------------------------
# 2) Back-transformed model means (beta-binomial) -> percent scale
# ---------------------------
emm_lymph <- emmeans(m_lymph_bb, ~ Treatment, type = "response") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  transmute(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("Control", "low", "high")),
    Cell_type = factor("Lymphocyte", levels = c("Lymphocyte", "Neutrophil")),
    mean_pct  = prob * 100,
    lower_pct = asymp.LCL * 100,
    upper_pct = asymp.UCL * 100
  )

emm_neut <- emmeans(m_neut_bb, ~ Treatment, type = "response") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  transmute(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("Control", "low", "high")),
    Cell_type = factor("Neutrophil", levels = c("Lymphocyte", "Neutrophil")),
    mean_pct  = prob * 100,
    lower_pct = asymp.LCL * 100,
    upper_pct = asymp.UCL * 100
  )

emm_both <- bind_rows(emm_lymph, emm_neut)

# ---------------------------
# 3) Colours (cell-type mapped)
# ---------------------------
fill_cells <- c(
  "Lymphocyte" = "#A8D5BA",  # pastel green
  "Neutrophil" = "#F5B7B1"   # pastel red
)

dark_cells <- c(
  "Lymphocyte" = "#2E8B57",  # dark green
  "Neutrophil" = "#B22222"   # dark red
)

dodge_w <- 0.75

# ---------------------------
# 4) Plot: side-by-side per treatment
# ---------------------------
p_lymphocyte_neutrophils <- ggplot(raw_long, aes(x = Treatment, y = Percent, fill = Cell_type)) +

  geom_violin(
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_w),
    alpha = 0.30,
    colour = NA,
    trim = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    aes(colour = Cell_type),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.12, dodge.width = dodge_w),
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 2
  ) +

  # Model means (do NOT inherit Percent mapping)
 geom_point(
  data = emm_both,
  aes(x = Treatment, y = mean_pct, fill = Cell_type),
  shape = 21,
  size = 5,
  stroke = 1.2,
  colour = "black",
  position = position_dodge(width = dodge_w),
  inherit.aes = FALSE
) +

  # 95% CI (do NOT inherit Percent mapping)
  geom_errorbar(
    data = emm_both,
    aes(x = Treatment, ymin = lower_pct, ymax = upper_pct, colour = Cell_type),
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_w),
    width = 0.18,
    linewidth = 1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_cells) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = dark_cells) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Fluoxetine treatment",
    y = "Differential leukocyte proportion (%)") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )

print(p_lymphocyte_neutrophils)

ggsave(
  filename = here::here("figures", "lymphocytes_neutrophils.pdf"),
  plot = p_lymphocyte_neutrophils,
  width = 6,
  height = 5
)

ggsave(
  filename = here::here("figures", "lymphocytes_neutrophils.jpg"),
  plot = p_lymphocyte_neutrophils,
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)

```

#Absolute number of lymphocyte
```{r}
# Create absolute lymphocyte estimate
data$Abs_Lymphocyte <- (data$Lymphocyte / 100) * data$total_wbc

# Inspect distribution
hist(data$Abs_Lymphocyte)

# Optional square root transformation if skewed
data$sqrt_Abs_Lymphocyte <- sqrt(data$Abs_Lymphocyte)

# Fit model
m_abs_lymph <- glmmTMB(
  sqrt_Abs_Lymphocyte ~ Treatment + Body_mass + (1 | Tank_ID),
  family = gaussian(),
  data = data
)

summary(m_abs_lymph)

# Diagnostics
res_abs_lymph <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(m_abs_lymph)
plot(res_abs_lymph)

DHARMa::testDispersion(res_abs_lymph)

# Type II test
Anova(m_abs_lymph)

# Estimated marginal means
emm_abs_lymph <- emmeans(m_abs_lymph, ~ Treatment)

pairs(emm_abs_lymph, adjust = "tukey")
```

#Absolute number of Neutrophil
```{r}
# Create absolute neutrophil abundance
data$Abs_Neutrophil <- (data$Neutrophil / 100) * data$total_wbc

# Inspect distribution
hist(data$Abs_Neutrophil)

# Square-root transformation
data$sqrt_Abs_Neutrophil <- sqrt(data$Abs_Neutrophil)

# Fit model
m_abs_neut <- glmmTMB(
  sqrt_Abs_Neutrophil ~ Treatment + Body_mass + (1 | Tank_ID),
  family = gaussian(),
  data = data
)

summary(m_abs_neut)

# Residual diagnostics
res_abs_neut <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(m_abs_neut)

plot(res_abs_neut)

DHARMa::testDispersion(res_abs_neut)

# Type II Wald tests
Anova(m_abs_neut)

# Estimated marginal means
emm_abs_neut <- emmeans(m_abs_neut, ~ Treatment)

pairs(emm_abs_neut, adjust = "tukey")

```

```{r}
# Plotting absolute lymphocytes and neutrophils

# Ensure treatment order
data$Treatment <- factor(
  data$Treatment,
  levels = c("Control", "low", "high")
)

# ---------------------------
# 1) Long-format raw data
# ---------------------------
raw_abs_long <- data %>%
  dplyr::select(Treatment, Abs_Lymphocyte, Abs_Neutrophil) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Abs_Lymphocyte, Abs_Neutrophil),
    names_to = "Cell_type",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Cell_type = dplyr::recode(
      Cell_type,
      "Abs_Lymphocyte" = "Lymphocyte",
      "Abs_Neutrophil" = "Neutrophil"
    ),
    Cell_type = factor(
      Cell_type,
      levels = c("Lymphocyte", "Neutrophil")
    )
  )

# ---------------------------
# 2) Back-transformed model means
# ---------------------------
emm_lymph_abs <- emmeans(m_abs_lymph, ~ Treatment) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Treatment = factor(
      Treatment,
      levels = c("Control", "low", "high")
    ),
    Cell_type = factor(
      "Lymphocyte",
      levels = c("Lymphocyte", "Neutrophil")
    ),
    mean_count  = emmean^2,
    lower_count = lower.CL^2,
    upper_count = upper.CL^2
  )

emm_neut_abs <- emmeans(m_abs_neut, ~ Treatment) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Treatment = factor(
      Treatment,
      levels = c("Control", "low", "high")
    ),
    Cell_type = factor(
      "Neutrophil",
      levels = c("Lymphocyte", "Neutrophil")
    ),
    mean_count  = emmean^2,
    lower_count = lower.CL^2,
    upper_count = upper.CL^2
  )

emm_abs_both <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  emm_lymph_abs,
  emm_neut_abs
)

# ---------------------------
# 3) Colours
# ---------------------------
fill_cells <- c(
  "Lymphocyte" = "#A8D5BA",
  "Neutrophil" = "#F5B7B1"
)

dark_cells <- c(
  "Lymphocyte" = "#2E8B57",
  "Neutrophil" = "#B22222"
)

dodge_w <- 0.75

# ---------------------------
# 4) Plot
# ---------------------------
p_abs_lymphocyte_neutrophils <- ggplot(
  raw_abs_long,
  aes(x = Treatment, y = Count, fill = Cell_type)
) +

  geom_violin(
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_w),
    alpha = 0.30,
    colour = NA,
    trim = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    aes(colour = Cell_type),
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.12,
      dodge.width = dodge_w
    ),
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 2
  ) +

  geom_errorbar(
    data = emm_abs_both,
    aes(
      x = Treatment,
      ymin = lower_count,
      ymax = upper_count,
      colour = Cell_type
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_w),
    width = 0.18,
    linewidth = 1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_point(
    data = emm_abs_both,
    aes(
      x = Treatment,
      y = mean_count,
      fill = Cell_type
    ),
    shape = 21,
    size = 5,
    stroke = 1.2,
    colour = "black",
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_w),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_cells) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = dark_cells) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +

  labs(
    x = "Fluoxetine treatment",
    y = "Absolute leukocyte count"
  ) +

  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )

# Display
p_abs_lymphocyte_neutrophils

# Save
ggsave(
  filename = here::here(
    "figures",
    "absolute_lymphocytes_neutrophils.pdf"
  ),
  plot = p_abs_lymphocyte_neutrophils,
  width = 6,
  height = 5
)

ggsave(
  filename = here::here(
    "figures",
    "absolute_lymphocytes_neutrophils.jpg"
  ),
  plot = p_abs_lymphocyte_neutrophils,
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)
```
